pick.headline: Khomeini returns to Iran
pick.summary: On 1 February 1979 Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini returned to Tehran after nearly fifteen years in exile, greeted by millions.
pick.significance: Within ten days the Shah's last government collapsed. The revolution cost Washington its main regional ally and its intelligence posts in Iran.

alternates.headline: Bush and Yeltsin declare end of Cold War rivalry at Camp David
alternates.summary: On 1 February 1992 Presidents Bush and Yeltsin met at Camp David and issued a declaration that Russia and the United States no longer regarded each other as potential adversaries.
alternates.significance: It was the first US-Russian summit after the Soviet Union's dissolution, and set the tone for early post-Soviet cooperation.
